ruledOutDirections.text: None this iteration. (The retired-mode name search is not a dead end: 0 hits is the verified absence that confirms README:562.)

Repo-wide `**/README.md` sweep as the inventory source: the find returns more than 100 paths, dominated by benchmark-report and fixture READMEs; the related set was built from root-README links plus the topic-named hubs instead.

Forcing the advisor CLI run past its freshness gate with `SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_CLI_DEV_ALLOW_STALE=1`: unnecessary; the shim's freshness check passed and `list-tools` exited 0 without any bypass, so the bypass env would have changed behavior without adding evidence.

Root `.nvmrc` or root `package.json` as the Node 24 enforcement source: both absent (cat probes returned not-found); the requirement is enforced per package via the four `engines` fields, so no root version file can be cited or expected.
Running `check-corpus.cjs --families` to list the check families: unnecessary; reading `FAMILY_NAMES` (lines 100-150) yields the same list without executing a script.
Running `create.sh` with an unknown option to observe the refusal: not executed; a scaffolder run risks writes, so the refusal was evidenced from the source token scan and the changelog instead.
`.skilled/README.md` as a related README to audit: the file does not exist and the root README has no reference to it (awk → 0 matches). Do not chase it in later iterations.

Mode READMEs for the three hubs as this iteration's audit target: the root README links no per-mode README for them (0 matches for `sk-git/README`; the only nested README it links is `system-spec-kit/runtime/README.md`, which remains on the Q4 inventory). Do not chase per-mode READMEs for these hubs again.

cli-devin README as an audit target this iteration: not in the Q1 inventory. Its observed lines (`README.md:12` `version: 1.4.0.11`, `SKILL.md:5` `version: 1.4.6.0`, newest changelog `v1.4.6.0.md`) are consistent with the own-edition model and are deferred.

Mode-packet README version parity as a drift class: closed by the frontmatter versioning standard — a mode README carries its own edition, raised by the bump rule, and only the parent-skill doctor's README check compares a hub root README with its `SKILL.md` [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-frontmatter/references/frontmatter-versioning.md:30], [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-frontmatter/references/frontmatter-versioning.md:122]. Do not re-chase cli-pi 1.5.0.8 vs 1.5.15.0.

An unknown-option note in `.skilled/scripts/README.md`: the v4.0.0.4 refusal set names the spec-kit CLI, the skill advisor, the deep loop, sk-doc, sk-code, sk-design, sk-git and the shared `.skilled/bin` tools, not `.skilled/scripts/`; only `orphan-mcp-sweeper.sh` already refuses an unknown argument (`:87`), so no README update is implicated.
Per-file READMEs inside `.skilled/bin/lib/compiled-routing/`: the README itself documents the directory is generated output that carries no README on purpose [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/lib/README.md:58].

A single multi-line awk program for the line re-print: a newline between the OR-chain pattern and its `{print}` action binds the action as an always-true rule, so it dumped whole files; per-file one-liner awks were used instead.

None beyond Ruled Out. The `.skilled/README.md` and root `spec/README.md` absence checks confirm the topic's premise errors rather than opening new work; the real spec README sits at `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/spec/README.md`.
Recovering iterations 1-5 full rows by matching the first table cell against `` | `path` ``: the rows' first cells do not match that shape; direct probes replaced the need.
